propos: One family, seven steps, three weights. Figures are fixed-width everywhere.
echelle-propos: Each step carries its size and its line height. Nothing in between.
regle-13: No text below 15 px, except 13 px for tab labels, the role marker, the counter and the day in the strip.

usage.32: System page heading, figure brought forward
usage.15: Secondary: date, source, English title, state marker
usage.13: Tab labels, role marker, counter, day in the strip

graisses-propos: Three weights, and italics in two of them.
italique-regle: Italics are reserved for English terms inside French text. They are used neither for emphasis nor for headings.
lettres: What the font must be able to draw
lettres-propos: The œ ligature, accented capitals and French quotation marks all exist in the font: that is what decided the choice.
phrase: « Au nom de ma délégation », l'œuvre d'Aïssatou à la CdP31 — ÉTAT DES LIEUX, ÎLE MAURICE, CÔTE D'IVOIRE.
lettres-note: Capital I, lowercase l and the figure 1 are told apart, as are O and 0: a room and a time are never read twice.
chiffres-propos: A column of times lines up digit by digit, whatever the hour.
chiffres-note: Fixed width is set once on the application boundary. On the right, the same times without it: the column stops lining up.
lecture-propos: The three steps of the “Aa” setting, applied to the body of a document.
